ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio approximately 85% low-intensity (dark) to 15% high-intensity (white) pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark central region with white high-intensity pigmentation localized along the leading edge margins and expanding into large contiguous patches at the distal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an acute angle and significant vertical depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged serrations with irregular peaks and valleys across the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated from the water-air interface.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature of the trailing edge originating from the median notch and terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured clusters of high-contrast raised nodes concentrated on the far lateral tips of both lobes; scattered white circular spots on the right lobe trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Barnacle encrustation on distal tips and white mottling/scarring on the inner right lobe near the trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible vertical water runoff streaks across the low-intensity ventral fluke surface.
